#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int dest, cap, flow, weight;
    Edge() {}
    Edge(int d, int c, int f, int w) : dest(d), cap(c), flow(f), weight(w) {}
};

vector<Edge> edges;
const int MAX_NODES = 14043;
vector<int> adj[MAX_NODES];
long long totalCost = 0;
long long dist[MAX_NODES];
int parent[MAX_NODES];
int parentEdge[MAX_NODES];
bool inQueue[MAX_NODES];
const long long INF = 1e18;

int source = MAX_NODES - 2;
int sink = MAX_NODES - 1;

int remaining(int idx) {
    return edges[idx].cap - edges[idx].flow;
}

void augmentPath() {
    fill(dist, dist + MAX_NODES, INF);
    fill(parent, parent + MAX_NODES, -1);
    fill(parentEdge, parentEdge + MAX_NODES, -1);
    fill(inQueue, inQueue + MAX_NODES, false);
    dist[source] = 0;
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(source);
    inQueue[source] = true;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front();
        q.pop();
        inQueue[u] = false;
        for (int eIdx : adj[u]) {
            if (remaining(eIdx) == 0) continue;
            int v = edges[eIdx].dest;
            int w = edges[eIdx].weight;
            if (dist[v] > dist[u] + w) {
                dist[v] = dist[u] + w;
                parent[v] = u;
                parentEdge[v] = eIdx;
                if (!inQueue[v]) {
                    inQueue[v] = true;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int cur = sink;
    while (cur != source) {
        edges[parentEdge[cur]].flow++;
        edges[parentEdge[cur] ^ 1].flow--;
        cur = parent[cur];
    }
    totalCost += dist[sink];
}

void addBidirectionalEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int weight) {
    adj[u].push_back(edges.size());
    edges.emplace_back(v, cap, 0, weight);
    adj[v].push_back(edges.size());
    edges.emplace_back(u, 0, 0, -weight);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, m, k, c, d_val;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d_val;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        --x;
        addBidirectionalEdge(source, x, 1, 0);
    }
    const int TIME_LIMIT = 101;
    for (int t = 0; t < TIME_LIMIT; ++t) {
        addBidirectionalEdge(t * n, sink, k, t * c);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        --u; --v;
        for (int t = 0; t < TIME_LIMIT - 1; ++t) {
            for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
                addBidirectionalEdge(u + t * n, v + (t + 1) * n, 1, d_val * (2 * j + 1));
            }
        }
        for (int t = 0; t < TIME_LIMIT - 1; ++t) {
            for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
                addBidirectionalEdge(v + t * n, u + (t + 1) * n, 1, d_val * (2 * j + 1));
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int t = 0; t < TIME_LIMIT - 1; ++t) {
            addBidirectionalEdge(i + t * n, i + (t + 1) * n, k, 0);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        augmentPath();
    }
    cout << totalCost << '\n';
    return 0;
}
